word: As with all matters of the heart, you'll know when you find it.
meaning: 就像所有關於心的事一樣，找到的時候你自然會知道。
example: Like recognizing true love, you will instinctively know when you have found your true calling.
hint:
中文解釋：呼應「愛情」的比喻——找到真正熱愛的工作時，那種感覺是直覺性的、確定的。
1) matters of the heart (phr.): 關於心、關於感情的事；syn: emotional matters; ant: logical matters
2) you'll know (phr.): 你會知道（本能感知）；syn: it will be obvious; ant: you'll be unsure
pronunciation: Gentle: as with ALL mat-ters of the HEART | you'll KNOW | when you FIND it.

word: And like any great relationship, it just gets better and better as the years roll on.
meaning: 就像任何美好的關係一樣，隨著歲月流逝，它只會越來越好。
example: Like a strong relationship, a true passion for your work grows deeper and more rewarding over time.
hint:
中文解釋：用「愛情」比喻持久的職業熱情——真正的愛不會褪色，只會更深厚。
1) great relationship (n.): 美好的關係；syn: strong bond; ant: toxic relationship
2) as the years roll on (phr.): 隨著歲月流逝；syn: over time; ant: immediately
pronunciation: Warm: like AN-y GREAT re-LA-tion-ship | it JUST gets BET-ter and BET-ter | as the YEARS ROLL ON.

example: His clear instruction: do not stop searching for your passion.
hint:
中文解釋：簡短的強調句，重申核心建議，語氣堅定而溫暖。
1) keep (v.): 持續；syn: continue; ant: stop
2) looking (v.): 尋找；syn: searching; ant: giving up
pronunciation: Clear command: So KEEP LOOK-ing. (brief, direct)

example: Never accept a life or career that does not truly fulfill you.
hint:
中文解釋：兩個字的核心哲學——在找到真正熱愛的事之前，不妥協、不將就。
1) settle (v.): 將就、接受次等；syn: compromise; ant: hold out for the best
2) don't (contr.): 不要；syn: never; ant: go ahead and
pronunciation: Firm: Don't SET-tle. (strong falling tone, very deliberate)

word: My third story is about death.
meaning: 我的第三個故事是關於死亡。
example: He introduces the final and most serious of his three stories.
hint:
中文解釋：清楚的段落標誌句，進入最深刻的主題——死亡。簡潔的宣告帶來震撼。
1) third story (n.): 第三個故事；syn: final tale; ant: first / second story
2) death (n.): 死亡；syn: mortality; ant: life
pronunciation: Solemn: My THIRD sto-ry | is a-BOUT | DEATH. (deliberate, quiet gravity)

word: When I was 17, I read a quote that went something like, 'If you live each day as if it was your last, someday you'll most certainly be right.'
meaning: 在我十七歲時，我讀到一句話，大意是：「如果你把每一天都當作生命的最後一天來過，有一天你一定是對的。」
example: At seventeen, a powerful quote about mortality made a lasting impression on him.
hint:
中文解釋：十七歲讀到的這句話，成為他此後三十三年每天的提醒。
1) live each day as if (phr.): 把每天都當作...來過；syn: treat every day like; ant: ignore mortality
2) most certainly (adv.): 幾乎可以確定地；syn: inevitably; ant: perhaps
pronunciation: Quoting: if you LIVE each DAY | as if it was your LAST | some-day you'll MOST cer-TAIN-ly be RIGHT.

word: It made an impression on me.
meaning: 這句話給我留下了深刻的印象。
example: That quote stayed with him and influenced how he thought about life.
hint:
中文解釋：簡單說明那句話的影響力——不只是讀過，而是真正觸動了他。
1) made an impression (phr.): 留下深刻印象；syn: had an impact; ant: was forgotten
2) on me (phr.): 對我；syn: affected me; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Simple: It made an im-PRES-sion on ME. (understated but meaningful)

word: And since then, for the past 33 years, I have looked in the mirror every morning and asked myself, 'If today were the last day of my life, would I wanna do what I am about to do today?'
meaning: 從那以後，在過去的三十三年裡，我每天早上都會照著鏡子問自己：「如果今天是我生命中的最後一天，我還會想做我即將要做的事嗎？」
example: For thirty-three years, he began every day by asking himself if it was worth spending as if it were his last.
hint:
中文解釋：具體而震撼的每日儀式——每天面對死亡的思考，讓他做出更真實的選擇。
1) looked in the mirror (phr.): 照鏡子（此處也象徵自我反思）；syn: examined himself; ant: avoided introspection
2) last day of my life (phr.): 生命的最後一天；syn: final day; ant: just another day
pronunciation: Long sentence: for the PAST 33 YEARS | LOOKED in the MIR-ror | if TO-day were the LAST DAY | would I WAN-na DO this?
